_comment: Copy this to data/recipes.json to teach Jarvis new apps, or to add
shortcuts to ones it already knows. Your file is merged over the
built-in table in skills/recipes.py -- and your 'actions' are ADDED to
the built-in ones rather than replacing them, so adding one shortcut
does not cost you the rest.
search_key    the shortcut that opens the app's search box
after_search  keys to press once the name is typed, to pick a result
settle        seconds to wait for results before picking (slow apps: more)
window_hint   part of the window title, if it differs from the app name
actions       what you would SAY, mapped to the keys to press
Key names: letters, digits, f1-f12, enter, tab, escape, space,
backspace, delete, up/down/left/right, home, end, pageup, pagedown,
comma, period, slash, semicolon, quote, backtick, minus, plus,
Restart Jarvis after editing. Ask 'what can you do in figma' to check.
